title: Chilli Bacon Breakfast Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 lean smoked bacon medallions, finely sliced
steps: Fry sliced bacon in a dry pan for a couple of minutes until cooked. Set aside.
Beat eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Spray a nonstick pan (similar size to wrap); heat high; pour in egg.
Sprinkle one-third of cheese over egg; cook 1 minute until nearly set but still slightly wet on top.
Place wrap over egg; press down. Cook 1 minute then flip (tortilla-side down).
Sprinkle remaining cheese and bacon over egg; drizzle chilli sauce.
Fold wrap in half; press gently. Lift to plate; cut in half. Serve immediately.
notes: Replace chilli sauce with brown sauce or ketchup. Vegetarian option: swap bacon for fried mushrooms, cherry tomatoes or onions.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
